1. 솔로몬의 인생론\n 1) 책의 제목은 ‘띠브레 코헬렛’회중의 스승의:
1. Solomon's philosophy of life
 1) The book's title is ‘Divrei Kohelet’, the words of the teacher of the assembly; today we'd call it a sermon.
2. 전도서를 푸는 열쇠는 뒤에 있다\n 1) 만약 전도서를 3장까지만:
2. The key to unlocking Ecclesiastes is at the end
 1) If you read Ecclesiastes only up to chapter 3 and stop, it becomes Buddhism. Vanity of vanities, all is vanity, it's all a big nothing.
 2) You can't find happiness in worldly things.
 - Solomon is someone who actually tried most of what we chase today. Wealth, honor, power, wisdom, knowledge, all sorts of women, pleasure, indulgence, and so on.
솔로몬이 자기 마음과 눈에 원하는 것을 금하지 않았다고 한다. 하지만 그: Solomon says he withheld nothing his heart and eyes desired. But the point is that it didn't give him happiness.
<전7:14> 형통한 날에는 기뻐하고 곤고한 날에는 생각하라 하나님이 이:
<Eccl 7:14> In the day of prosperity be joyful, but in the day of adversity consider: God also hath set the one over against the other, to the end that man should find nothing after him.
 - So we must always live thoughtfully.
여러분 이게 정말 중요해요. 곤고한 날이 오지 않으면 사람이 잠깐 멈추고:
Folks, this is really important. It's really important for people to stop for a moment and think, but if days of adversity don't come, they hardly ever do.
 - Solomon realized it too.
<전9:9> 네 헛된 평생의 모든 날 곧 하나님이 해 아래서 네게 주신:
<Eccl 9:9> Live joyfully with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of the life of thy vanity, which he hath given thee under the sun, all the days of thy vanity: for that is thy portion in this life, and in thy labour which thou takest under the sun.
 - If he'd known this early on, he wouldn't have brought in a thousand women. He was corrupted something awful, then at the very end came to his senses, wrote his testimony, Ecclesiastes, and died.
 3) You have to look at the last part.
<전11:9> 청년이여 네 어린 때를 즐거워하며 네 청년의 날을 마음에: <Eccl 11:9> Rejoice, O young man, in thy youth; and let thy heart cheer thee in the days of thy youth, and walk in the ways of thine heart, and in the sight of thine eyes: but know thou, that for all these things God will bring thee into judgment.
난 청년이 아니니까 괜찮겠지? 하는 거 아니죠?: You're not thinking, "I'm not young, so I'm fine," are you?
<전12:14> 일의 결국을 다 들었으니 하나님을 경외하고 그 명령을 지:
<Eccl 12:14> Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man. For God shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether it be good, or whether it be evil.
 - Vanity is not the conclusion. The conclusion is that we must know the whole duty of man and live always keeping in mind that there is a judgment. That is the conclusion of Ecclesiastes.
